candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout; the gateway's own latency is low, so the failure originates in the order dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause of the order 500 (e.g. db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, bad-configuration) is not established; order-side logs/metrics were not admitted.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s caused by order service 500s on POST /v1/orders across multiple correlation IDs; gateway p95 latency is modest and metrics show 502s on /v1/checkout. Bounded candidate is http-500 at the order service; the specific underlying fault requires order-side evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service logs and error details for the 500 responses on /v1/orders
Order service dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to distinguish db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, or bad-configuration
Excluded gateway logs (ev-f430679fd864ea83-r0-gw_logs) to confirm error propagation
